high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the world television premiere of a movie titled "Blue Star." The poster features two individuals on a cricket field, both holding cricket bats and appearing to be in a batting stance. People: There are two men in the image. One is wearing a plaid shirt and dark pants, while the other is dressed in traditional cricket whites, including pads and gloves. Objects: Both individuals are holding cricket bats, and there is a set of stumps (the three vertical posts at the end of the pitch) prominently displayed in the foreground.
